description: Pharmacology for a drug (molecule): mechanism(s) of action, the molecular target(s) it acts on, action type (inhibitor / agonist / …), first-approval year, and clinical indications with the max phase reached for each. Supply molecule_chembl_id (from chembl_search_molecules) — a parent or any of its salts and other alternate forms gives the same answer: ChEMBL often records a drug's mechanisms and approved indications on a salt, so both lists cover the whole family under parent_molecule_chembl_id. Each mechanism names the form it is recorded on, and each indication is listed once per MeSH/EFO pair at the highest phase any form reached, with the forms it is recorded on, each at its own phase. Distinct from the openfda server's label/adverse-event view — this is the curated mechanism-and-indication record. A mechanism's target_chembl_id chains into chembl_get_bioactivities for compounds hitting the same target. Each list carries its own retrieval state: an empty mechanisms or indications array means the molecule has none recorded only when the matching mechanisms_status / indications_status is "complete" — "failed" means the list was not retrieved (the request ran out of time or ChEMBL answered with an error, as the matching *_failure says) and the array says nothing about the molecule, and "truncated" means the page cap fetched fewer rows than ChEMBL holds, which the matching *_total_count reports.

molecule_chembl_id.description: ChEMBL molecule ID (from chembl_search_molecules), e.g. "CHEMBL939" for gefitinib, or the molecule's standard InChIKey, e.g. "XGALLCVXEZPNRQ-UHFFFAOYSA-N". A salt or other alternate form answers with its parent's family, the same as the parent.

name: chembl_get_drug_info

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `not_found`: ChEMBL has no record for the requested identifier or structure. `rate_limited`: ChEMBL rate-limits the upstream request. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

first_approval.description: Year of first approval, e.g. 2003. Null when unapproved or unknown.

indications.description: Clinical indications. Empty is authoritative only when indications_status is "complete". When "truncated", each indication's max_phase_for_ind and forms are lower bounds: rows past the page cap can raise a phase or add a form.

items.description: One clinical indication, listed once per MeSH/EFO pair across the drug and its alternate forms, with the highest phase reached for it and the phase each form reached.

efo_id.description: EFO ontology ID, e.g. "EFO:0003060". Null when absent.

efo_term.description: EFO disease term, e.g. "non-small cell lung carcinoma". Null when absent.

forms.description: The forms of the drug the indication is recorded on, each with its own highest phase for it. Empty when ChEMBL names none.

items.description: One form the indication is recorded on, at its own phase.

max_phase_for_ind.description: Max clinical phase THIS form reached for the indication — a deuterated analog can sit lower than its parent. Null when unknown.

molecule_chembl_id.description: A form of the drug the indication is recorded on — the parent, or one of its salts or other alternate forms.

max_phase_for_ind.description: Max clinical phase reached for THIS indication (1–4), the highest across the forms it is recorded on. Null when unknown.

mesh_heading.description: MeSH disease heading, e.g. "Carcinoma, Non-Small-Cell Lung". Null when absent.

mesh_id.description: MeSH descriptor ID, e.g. "D002289". Null when absent.

indications_failure.description: Why the indication list failed, when indications_status is "failed": "timeout" = the request ran out of time before ChEMBL returned the list; "upstream_error" = ChEMBL answered with an error (a rate limit, a server error, a rejected request) or could not be reached. Null when the list did not fail.

indications_rows_fetched.description: Indication rows fetched from ChEMBL for the molecule and its alternate forms, before rows recorded on several forms merge. When the status is "truncated", each row not fetched (indications_total_count minus this) can add at most one indication, so that difference bounds the indications missing. Null when the fetch failed.

indications_status.description: Retrieval state of the indication list. "complete" = every row ChEMBL records for the molecule and its alternate forms is present, so an empty array is a fact about the molecule. "truncated" = the single-request page cap bounded the list, so the array holds the indications of the rows fetched (indications_rows_fetched, fewer than indications_total_count). "failed" = the list was not retrieved (the request ran out of time or ChEMBL answered with an error, as indications_failure says), so the empty array is unknown data, NOT evidence that none exist — re-call chembl_get_drug_info to retry.

indications_total_count.description: When the status is "complete", the number of distinct indications — the returned array length, rows recorded on several forms counted once. When "truncated", the indication rows ChEMBL holds for the molecule and its alternate forms, an upper bound on the distinct indications. Null when the fetch failed — the count is unknown, never 0.

max_phase.description: Max clinical phase across indications: 4 = marketed. Null when unknown.

mechanisms.description: Mechanisms of action. Empty is authoritative only when mechanisms_status is "complete".

items.description: One mechanism of action linked to its molecular target.

action_type.description: Action type, e.g. "INHIBITOR", "AGONIST", "ANTAGONIST". Null when absent.

mechanism_of_action.description: Mechanism of action, e.g. "Epidermal growth factor receptor erbB1 inhibitor". Null when absent.

molecule_chembl_id.description: The form of the drug the mechanism is recorded on — the parent, or one of its salts or other alternate forms. Null when ChEMBL names none.

target_chembl_id.description: ChEMBL target ID the mechanism acts on — chain to chembl_get_bioactivities. Null when unspecified.

mechanisms_failure.description: Why the mechanism list failed, when mechanisms_status is "failed": "timeout" = the request ran out of time before ChEMBL returned the list; "upstream_error" = ChEMBL answered with an error (a rate limit, a server error, a rejected request) or could not be reached. Null when the list did not fail.

mechanisms_status.description: Retrieval state of the mechanism list. "complete" = every row ChEMBL records for the molecule and its alternate forms is present, so an empty array is a fact about the molecule. "truncated" = the single-request page cap bounded the list, so the array is a prefix of mechanisms_total_count rows. "failed" = the list was not retrieved (the request ran out of time or ChEMBL answered with an error, as mechanisms_failure says), so the empty array is unknown data, NOT evidence that none exist — re-call chembl_get_drug_info to retry.

mechanisms_total_count.description: Total mechanism rows ChEMBL holds for the molecule and its alternate forms. Exceeds the returned array length exactly when the status is "truncated". Null when the fetch failed — the count is unknown, never 0.

molecule_chembl_id.description: The ChEMBL molecule ID queried, as the molecule's own record writes it.

notice.description: Disclosure of anything the two lists do not say for themselves: a list whose upstream fetch timed out or failed (so its emptiness means nothing), a list the page cap bounded, or — only when both lists came back complete and empty — that the molecule may be a research compound rather than a drug.

parent_molecule_chembl_id.description: The parent of the queried molecule's family — the molecule itself when it is the parent or ChEMBL records no hierarchy for it. Both lists cover this parent and every alternate form ChEMBL files under it (salts, isotope-labelled and deuterated analogs).

pref_name.description: Preferred drug name, e.g. "GEFITINIB". Null when unnamed.

title: chembl-get-drug-info
